label: Apple — scab
look_for: Olive-green to dark, velvety or scabby spots on leaves, often along the veins.

label: Apple — cedar apple rust
look_for: Bright yellow-orange spots on the upper leaf surface, sometimes with small tufts underneath.

label: Apple — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaf without spots, discoloured patches or unusual curling.

label: Blueberry — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaf without spots, reddening patches or dead margins.

label: Cherry — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaf without white powdery coating, spots or holes.

label: Corn — gray leaf spot
look_for: Narrow, rectangular grey to tan lesions running parallel to the leaf veins.

label: Corn — common rust
look_for: Small, raised, cinnamon-brown pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces.

label: Corn — northern leaf blight
look_for: Long, cigar-shaped grey-green to tan lesions, often several centimetres long.

label: Grape — black rot
look_for: Round tan to brown spots with a dark border, sometimes with tiny black dots inside.

label: Grape — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaf without spots, dark borders or dried patches.

label: Peach — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaf without small holes, spots or puckering.

label: Bell pepper — bacterial spot
look_for: Small, water-soaked spots that turn brown, sometimes with yellowing around them.

label: Bell pepper — healthy
look_for: Evenly green, glossy leaf without spots or yellow patches.

label: Potato — early blight
look_for: Brown spots with concentric rings (a target pattern), often on older leaves first.

label: Potato — late blight
look_for: Irregular dark, water-soaked patches, sometimes with pale growth at the edges in damp weather.

label: Raspberry — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaflets without spots, yellowing or rust-coloured pustules.

label: Soybean — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaflets without spots, mottling or yellowing.

label: Squash — powdery mildew
look_for: White, powdery patches on the leaf surface that can spread to cover the leaf.

label: Strawberry — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaflets without purple-bordered spots or scorched edges.

label: Tomato — bacterial spot
look_for: Many small, dark, greasy-looking spots, sometimes with yellow halos.

label: Tomato — early blight
look_for: Brown spots with concentric rings (a target pattern), usually starting on lower leaves.

label: Tomato — late blight
look_for: Large, irregular dark patches that look water-soaked, spreading quickly in wet weather.

label: Tomato — leaf mold
look_for: Pale yellow patches on top of the leaf with olive-grey, fuzzy growth underneath.

label: Tomato — Septoria leaf spot
look_for: Many small round spots with a dark edge and a lighter grey-tan centre.

label: Tomato — mosaic virus
look_for: Light and dark green mottled (mosaic) pattern, sometimes with distorted leaves.

label: Tomato — yellow leaf curl virus
look_for: Leaves curling upward with yellow edges, often small and crinkled.

label: Tomato — healthy
look_for: Evenly green leaf without spots, mottling, curling or yellow patches.
